status_definitions.SHIPPED: Present in the release candidate, train R1g (and the trains named), with the patch group and the test that prove it. No train has been deployed: ops/RELEASE-LOG.md has no row and production still serves deploy 6abd6d62.
status_definitions.BUILT_NOT_SHIPPED: Exists in src/, historian-src/, data-src/, candidates/ or as an opt-in patch group, but is in no train; the evidence says what is missing.
status_definitions.OPEN_BUILDABLE: Not built, or built in part; the remaining work can be done in this container.
status_definitions.OPEN_NEEDS_DECISION: Waits for a decision that the owner delegated on 2026-11-11; next_step carries the conservative proposal and the alternative that stays selectable.
status_definitions.OWNER_ONLY: Needs a legal act, an account, a key, a DNS change, a payment, a deployment, real hardware or a third party; owner_step is the exact step.
status_definitions.SUPERSEDED: Overtaken by a later owner decision or standing constraint.
status_definitions.size: Size of the remaining work: S under half a day, M half a day to two days, L more than two days. S for items with nothing left to build.

kinds.work-package: A whole work package (WP-INFRA, WP-SEO, WP-CONTENT, WP-QA, WP-DATA, WP-HIST) decided as one.
kinds.work-package-part: One part (letter suffix) of a work package that mixes statuses.
kinds.audit-id: One of the 57 audit ids of chapter 16 section 3 (AUDIT-xx); status is the state of the finding in the candidate, closing work packages named.
kinds.audit-correction: One of the 28 corrections of chapter 16 section 1.2 (CORR-nn).
kinds.exit-criterion: An exit criterion of the audit annex (EXIT-16-n).
kinds.verification-debt: V1..V20 of chapter 15 section 9, the annex verifications VER16-n, and three debts found by this survey (VER-COPY-SUITE, VER-HIST-NODE, VER-HIST-CORPUS).
kinds.chapter-decision: An owner decision of chapter 15 (OD-n) or of the chapter tables (INFRA-OD, OD-SEO, CD, QA-OD, Q-DATA, HIST-OD, O-16); the register ADRs are in items-A.json.
kinds.decision-gate: A decision gate DG-0..DG-5 of 15-roadmap.json: a date by which the owner decisions of the chapter tables were due; carried here so that no decision date of the plan goes unrecorded.

items.title: The Historian corpus build and the 87 tests that need it have never run in this container (the archive.org download path is blocked here)
items.evidence: Found by this survey, 2026-11-13. The whole Historian suite (candidates/r1h/ver-hist-node log tmp/r1h-cand/ver-hist-node/suite-node22-normal.log: 478 tests, 391 pass, 0 fail, 87 skipped under Node 22.23.4) skips 87 tests, all for one reason: 79 need historian-src/raw/or27 (git-ignored; written by node tools/historian/ingest/corpus.mjs build) and 8 need tmp/historian-cache. So the corpus-level claims of the BUILT items (report and dispatch segmentation, the linkers and their labelled set, the time-claim extraction, the passage checks VI-TX-1..5 and VI-CK-3) are proven here only by the tests that do not need the corpus, and the committed tables historian-src/corpus/or27/*.json have not been reproduced here. The build reads 15 files of the Internet Archive items warofrebellion271unit, 272unit and 273unit (djvu.txt, page_numbers.json, scandata.xml, hocr_pageindex.json.gz, hocr_searchtext.txt.gz; about 20 MB; the sha256 of each is in historian-src/corpus/or27/manifest.json).
